raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 6, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the search result that identified “New York Governor Nelson Rockefeller’s Committee...” and incorrectly concluded the relevant U.S. Vice President was Spiro Agnew. Rockefeller himself later served as U.S. Vice President (1974–77); Agnew was unrelated to Rockefeller’s committee. The Planner failed to verify by opening the cited source and made an erroneous association, leading to the wrong final answer.
